title: ninja food pro 6.5 qt plus air fryer
text: ninja food pro 6.5 qt plus air fryer. I went out on a ledge here, I purchased two.  One for myself and one for a good friend.  My good friend has been using hers nearly every day with great glee.  I am so happy with this purchase.  If you've been thinking about purchasing a pressure cooker - this one is the TOP of the food chain.  It does EVERYTHING really well.  You can start and finish with just one pan.  A whole meal.  Easy to use.  Easy to clean.  I am not sure it gets better than this - unless it would be to have a private chef to cook the meals for you!  I am having a great time researching new recipes on multiple venues - there are so many - something for everyone omnivore, carnivore, vegetarian, vegan, etc...  If you're thinking about it - don't hesitate to try this one. Having said all of this,  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Ninja OS401 Foodi 10-in-1 XL 8 qt. Pressure Cooker & Air Fryer that Steams, Slow Cooks, Sears, Sautés, Dehydrates & More, with 5.6 qt. Cook & Crisp Plate & 15 Recipe Book, Silver
features: XL PRESSURE COOKER THAT CRISPS: Meet the Ninja Foodi 10-in-1 8-quart XL Pressure Cooker that provides the best of pressure cooking and air frying all in one pot for endless meal options.

10-in-1 VERSATILITY: 10 versatile functions allow you to pressure cook, air crisp, sear/sauté, steam, slow cook, yogurt, sous vide, keep warm, bake/roast, broil, dehydrate, and reheat at the press of a button.
TENDERCRISP TECHNOLOGY: Quickly pressure cook to lock in moisture and then finish with a crisp with TenderCRISP Technology.
FROM FROZEN TO CRISPY: Air fry chicken wings in as little as 20 minutes, and cook a 7-lb chicken in less than an hour. (Based on cook time under pressure and crisping).
FASTER COOKING: Pressure Cook up to 70% faster than traditional cooking methods. (Versus slow-cooked, braised, or low-simmer recipes).
LESS FAT: Air Fry with up to 75% less fat than traditional frying methods. (Tested against deep-fried, hand-cut french fries).
XL FAMILY-SIZED CAPACITY: With 8-qt. cooking capacity, and stainless steel reversible rack, you can steam, broil, add a layer of capacity, and cook mains and sides at the same time for family meals.
EASY-TO-CLEAN: 8-qt cooking pot and 5.6-qt Cook & Crisp Plate are nonstick and dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.
CHEF-INSPIRED RECIPES: Includes 15 chef-inspired recipes and additional cooking charts for meal-making inspiration.
WHAT'S INCLUDED: Pressure Cooker, 2 Lids, 8-Qt. Cooking Pot, 5.6-Qt. Cook & Crisp Plate, Reversible Rack & 15 Recipe Guide.
